title: Kalshi Not Running 'a Casino' Says Head of Enforcement
summary: Robert DeNault, Kalshi's head of enforcement and legal counsel, responded to a lawsuit brought New York State, saying that he is concerned about overreach coming from Attorney General Letitia James's office. DeNault defended Kalshi's operations saying that his company is platforming open marketplaces, not functioning as a casino or a sportsbook.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Signals Steady Debt Sales to 2027, Offers ‘Subtle’ Change
summary: The US Treasury on Wednesday retained its previous guidance for future debt issuance, signaling no change in note and bond auction sizes well into 2027 even as federal borrowing needs climb.

title: Fitch Adds to Hundreds of CLOs Slated for Rating Upgrades
summary: Fitch Ratings said it’s upgrading 30 portions of collateralized loan obligations, in addition to the hundreds of tranches it had said previously it was considering for upgrades under a new methodology.

title: Need CEO Search For Ethan Allen: Bergeron
summary:
Douglas Bergeron, founder of DGB Investments, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." DGB Investments founder Douglas Bergeron has built a stake in Ethan Allen Interiors and is pushing to replace the furniture company’s entire board of directors.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AstraZeneca Is Said to Have Explored Bristol Myers Merger
summary:
Bloomberg's Michelle Davis joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." AstraZeneca has explored an acquisition of Bristol-Myers Squibb, according to people familiar with the matter, in a potential megadeal that would rank as the largest ever in pharma.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 5
summary: Oil fell for a third straight session on signs that the US and Iran are nearing a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restore millions of barrels of daily shipments disrupted by months of war.

title: Ares Eyes $2 Billion Loan Deal in Private Credit’s Slow Year
summary: Ares Management Corp. is leading a $2.2 billion direct loan to help finance a healthcare services acquisition, in one of the biggest deals since the private credit market was roiled by record redemptions this year.

title: Carry Trade Is Powering On as Investors Sidestep Yen’s Gains
summary: Emerging-market carry trades, some of this year’s most popular foreign-exchange bets, are showing resilience even after joint US-Japan currency intervention dented the appeal of this yen-funded strategy.

title: Everyone Is Chasing Scale: Petillo-Décossard
summary: Kimberly Petillo-Décossard, global co-head of M&A White & Case, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the current state of dealmaking, market volatility, and how the federal regulatory environment affects the flow of deals. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apollo’s Deal Spree Drives Fee-Related Revenue to a Record
summary:
Bloomberg's Laura Benitez joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Apollo Global Management reported record revenue from fees as it vies to be one of Wall Street’s largest lenders.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iran Says No Decision Yet on Second Stage of US Talks
summary: Former Assistant Secretary of State Barbara Leaf said that a potential deal between the US and Iran on the Strait of Hormuz would simply reset the negotiating table for more detailed discussions on the wider war and that she does not believe there is credibility to President Trump's threats that this is Iran's 'last chance' to come to the table.  Leaf said that in terms of negotiation timeline, she believes it would be 'exceptionally difficult' to reach durable agreements by November.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Erase Gains as Nvidia’s Rally Offsets Rate Hike Rumbles
summary: US stocks on Wednesday afternoon erased the morning’s gains, following Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari’s comment that it’s time for the central bank to start slowly raising rates and as strategists see profit taking in the recent tech rally. Megacap Nvidia Corp. extended its rally into a fifth day on confidence in artificial-intelligence related spending, contributing the most to the S&P 500 Index on a points basis.

title: Ghana Made $1.9 Billion Loss on Gold Purchases in 2025, IMF Says
summary: Ghana’s central bank incurred losses of 22 billion cedis ($1.9 billion) in 2025 under a domestic gold purchase program aimed at boosting the country’s foreign-exchange reserves.

title: Polymarket Seeks Investment at More Than $20B Valuation
summary:
Bloomberg's Todd Gillespie joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Polymarket is seeking to raise capital at a valuation of more than $20 billion, months after it closed an earlier round with new investment from hedge fund D.E. Shaw & Co.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mosaic Phosphate Pains Highlight Hormuz Fertilizer Disruption
summary: Mosaic Co.’s pullbacks in fertilizer production haven’t been enough to alleviate the impact of surging input costs from the war in Iran.

title: Arini, Silver Point Among Lenders Set to Take Over Pfleiderer
summary: A bondholder group is set to take over Pfleiderer, the struggling wood-paneling company backed by Strategic Value Partners, despite the firm raising fresh debt just eight months ago.

title: BC Partners’ Credit Arm Explores Extending Lifeline to LIV Golf
summary: BC Partners’ credit arm is leading a group of investors looking at lending money to LIV Golf, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Boeing-Lockheed Rocket Joint Venture Taps Private Bond Market
summary: Boeing Co. and Lockheed Martin Corp.’s rocket joint venture plans to sell bonds in the private market to refinance debt.

title: Colombia Seizes Explosives Ahead of De la Espriella Inauguration
summary: Colombian authorities intercepted a bus rigged with explosives in the country’s southwest on Wednesday, underscoring security concerns ahead of President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella’s inauguration.
